task: A 6-week paid-social campaign had strong CTR (2.8%, above your 1.5% benchmark) but conversion rate on the landing page was only 0.4% (benchmark 2%). Diagnose the most likely cause and recommend the single highest-leverage fix -- do not recommend 'just run more ads' or 'try a different platform,' since the data points to a specific stage of the funnel.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) correctly identifies the landing page / post-click experience as the likely failure point (high CTR + low conversion = the ad is working, the page isn't); (b) does NOT recommend more ad spend or platform-switching as the primary fix; (c) proposes a specific, testable landing-page hypothesis (e.g. message mismatch between ad and page, page load speed, unclear CTA, mobile rendering) rather than a vague 'optimize the page.'
